content: MDN 官方文档明确指出：You need to pay attention to local testing — if you try to load the HTML file locally (i.e., with a file:// URL), you'll run into CORS errors due to JavaScript module security requirements. You need to do your testing through a server. 因此 Vite 构建出的 ESM 产物必须通过本地 HTTP/HTTPS 服务器提供服务，base: './' 不能用于绕过浏览器安全限制通过 file:// 直接双击运行。
